fork.note: LOCAL-FIXTURE ONLY (scripts/official/empty_rpc.py, empty state) — NOT a mainnet-fork replay. block_number is a non-zero placeholder (approx. Ethereum height on 2024-08-06) required by the runner; no on-chain state is read.

contracts.note: Minimal reconstruction; no production addresses asserted. Funds returned by the whitehat.

root_cause_summary.vulnerable_pattern: The bridge upgrade's initializeV3 (which sets totalOperatorWeight) was never called; only initializeV4 ran. minimumVoteWeight() computed from a zero total weight is 0, so a withdrawal passes with no operator votes.
root_cause_summary.verification_bypass: Withdrawal vote-weight threshold collapsed to zero; an empty signer set clears it. No signatures are forged.
root_cause_summary.fix: Run initializeV3 during the upgrade so totalOperatorWeight is set and the real threshold is enforced.
root_cause_summary.deployment_defect: Root cause was the deployment procedure (skipped initializer), not contract logic. Modelled as a code-level end-state difference because the harness runs one shared setup.

exploit_characteristics.style: withdrawal with empty operator signer set accepted due to zero threshold
exploit_characteristics.notes: ~3,996 ETH + ~1,998,046 USDC withdrawn (~$10M-$12M). Whitehat; funds returned. Distinct from the March 2022 Ronin validator key-compromise incident (Group B).
